decisions.reason: After two years with no visible follow-up beyond its 2019 homepage appearance, the mobile app looks like a weakly differentiated, adjacent option whose likely payoff has been revealed as too limited to justify continued support.

PassBoard appears to be the most substantive and strategically aligned airport-processing option, and because it was launched only at the end of 2019 its commercial value was still obscured by unusual market conditions, making it worth keeping open a bit longer.

The self-service check-in solution shows no evidence of traction after launch and is close enough to the firm's other passenger-processing offers that management would likely reallocate resources rather than keep multiple overlapping options alive.
